## About

Mohd Israr (also known as Israr) is an India-based PHP developer and full stack engineer. He builds CRM integrations, workflow automation systems, and SaaS products using PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, Angular, Vue.js, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs. He integrates third-party platforms including Stripe, PayPal, Authorize.Net, QuickBooks, AWS S3, and cloud services.

## Skills

- Languages: PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, Java, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, AJAX
- Frameworks: Laravel, Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Symfony, Phalcon
- CRM & automation: HubSpot CRM, CRM migration, workflow automation, webhooks, REST APIs, OAuth, payment gateway integration
- Databases & cloud: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS S3, AWS SNS
- Tools: Docker, Postman, Git, Swagger, PGAdmin, MySQL Workbench, Composer
